note: El juego incluye 8 cartas de Misión, de las cuales se usan 3 al azar por partida. Solo se transcribió el ejemplo completo mostrado en el manual (Pits of Hathsin). Las otras 7 se conocen solo por nombre y por descripciones generales de la guía comunitaria de Zen -- NO se tienen los valores numéricos exactos de sus recompensas verificados de una imagen real. Antes de usar estos datos en el simulador, hay que fotografiar las 8 cartas de Misión físicas para completar esto con precisión.

fully_verified_example.name: Pits of Hathsin
fully_verified_example.source: rulebook page 14, shown as full anatomy example
fully_verified_example.top_reward: one-time, appears to grant Atium (per community guide: 2 Atium total on completion)
fully_verified_example.top_reward_first_player_bonus: always one-time even if top reward is permanent
fully_verified_example.community_assessment: [Zen] ranks this Mission as D-tier (lowest) for Solo/Co-op because the tier-3 payoff arrives too late (~turn 14) to matter in most games.

named_only_not_verified.name: Canton Of Orthodoxy
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] S-tier - can eliminate up to 9 cards for first finisher via repeated Soothe-style rewards

named_only_not_verified.name: Keep Venture
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] S-tier - 11 gold across 5 checkpoints, permanent +2 gold/turn on completion

named_only_not_verified.name: Luthadel Garrison
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] A-tier - modest damage, first-player rewards destroy Adversary shields

named_only_not_verified.name: Kredik Shaw
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] A-tier - grants extra card draws at 3 points, permanent +1 draw/turn on completion

named_only_not_verified.name: Skaa Caverns
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] B-tier - refreshes 2 metals, better at higher difficulty

named_only_not_verified.name: Crew Hideout
named_only_not_verified.community_tier_note: [Zen] C-tier - up to 14 total healing across the track, nothing else
